valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the income statement and the balance sheet share no period (income newest HY 2026, balance newest FY2025), so earnings, book value and the market cap cannot be put on one period. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
